# Kevin Buck

<div class="hero-position">
Postdoctoral Researcher, Brown University<br>
Department of Mathematics · 2026–present

<div class="hero-summary">

## Research highlights
[Research overview →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-card}
### Scientific machine learning
Error estimates and adaptive sampling for physics-informed neural networks, with applications to phase-transition systems.

[PINN analysis and methods →](research.qmd#physics-informed-neural-networks)
:::
::: {.research-card}
### Singularity formation
Computer-assisted proofs of finite-time blow-up for energy-supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equations.

[Singularities in nonlinear PDEs →](research.qmd#singularities-and-magnetic-spectral-problems)
:::
::: {.research-card}
### Spectral theory
Magnetic Schrödinger operators, exact eigenvalue crossings, and stability questions in nonlinear PDEs.

[Spectral problems and stability →](research.qmd#singularities-and-magnetic-spectral-problems)
:::
:::
